For the Petitioner : Mr. Rishu Ranjan, Advocate For the State : Mr. Prabhu Dayal Agrawal, A.P.P.
--------
Order No. 06 / Dated 14th June, 2024 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned A.P.P. appearing on behalf of the State.

2. Petitioner seeks protection in terms of Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure as he is apprehending his arrest in connection with Daltonganj Town P.S. Case No. 373 of 2023 for the offence registered under Sections 406, 420 and 409 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 7 of the Essential Commodity Act, pending in the Court of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Daltonganj.
3. It is submitted on behalf of the petitioner that the entire allegations as stated in the F.I.R. are of civil nature arising out of the agreement and no criminal offence is made out.

It is further submitted that the allegation made in the F.I.R is that this petitioner is running a rice mill as stated and supplied less quantity of rice than the agreed quantity to the tune of 10445.65 quintal.
4. The learned A.P.P for the State submitted that let the case diary be called and be allowed to file counter-affidavit in this case.
5. Having heard learned counsel for the parties, perused the record of the case.
6. Under this circumstance, accordingly, let the case diary be called for and a counter-affidavit be filed by the next of hearing positively on behalf of State.
